note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. CON-NODE01 and CON-NODE02 are throwaway Server Core VMs; the build runs on CON-NODE01 (New-Cluster cannot run remotely without CredSSP). If installing the feature asks for a restart, restart the node, reopen the scene and re-run the same Build command (the plan is rebuilt from the facts). The drain and crash screens are app screens: two windows are recorded side by side.
prepare: # owner creates CON-NODE01 (10.50.0.51) and CON-NODE02 (10.50.0.52): Server Core, domain-joined, checkpoint pre-ep12: see needs vm:CON-NODE01, vm:CON-NODE02
if ((Test-Connection 10.50.0.60 -Count 1 -Quiet) -or (Test-Connection 10.50.0.61 -Count 1 -Quiet)) { throw "10.50.0.60 or 10.50.0.61 already answers: choose free clustered addresses first" }
Invoke-Command -Session $n1 { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\lab | Out-Null; Remove-Item C:\lab\ep12 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
Invoke-Command -Session $s2 { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\lab | Out-Null; Remove-Item C:\lab\ep12 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
Invoke-Command -VMName CON-NODE01 -Credential $cred { Test-WSMan CON-NODE02 | Out-Null; Test-WSMan CON-SRV01 | Out-Null }

screens.name: drain
screens.app: VMConnect: CON-SRV02 (prober) and CON-NODE01 (drain), side by side
steps: CON-SRV02, Windows PowerShell, cd C:\lab\ep12\src: .\Watch-ClusterRole.ps1 -Url http://10.50.0.61/ -DurationSec 90 -OutFile .\drain.jsonl
About 15 seconds later, on the CON-NODE01 console (powershell, cd C:\lab\ep12\src): .\Deploy-ClusterLab.ps1 -Step Drain -WhatIf
Show the From / To row on CON-NODE01 and, in the prober window, the "Served by" line changing from one node to the other
Wait for the prober to finish and show the outage table at the end (the probe has a 2 s timeout, so an outage is measured to about two seconds)
mask: VMConnect title bar ("<VM> on <laptop name>") and the laptop taskbar

screens.name: crash
screens.app: Hyper-V host PowerShell and the CON-SRV02 prober window (optional screen)
steps: Find the owner node on the surviving node first: Get-ClusterGroup CON-WEB
On the Hyper-V host, elevated PowerShell: Stop-VM -Name <the owning node> -TurnOff
Show the role come online on the other node and the longer outage in the prober summary
Afterwards: Start-VM -Name <the owning node> and wait for the node to rejoin the cluster before tear-down
mask: VMConnect title bar ("<VM> on <laptop name>") and the laptop taskbar
the host computer name in the host prompt or window title

teardown: Get-VM CON-NODE01, CON-NODE02 | Where-Object State -ne 'Running' | Start-VM
do { Start-Sleep -Seconds 10; $ok = try { Invoke-Command -VMName CON-NODE01 -Credential $cred { $true } -ErrorAction Stop } catch { $false } } until ($ok)

$vm = Get-VM -Name CON-NODE01 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($vm) { $disks = @($vm | Get-VMHardDiskDrive | ForEach-Object Path | Where-Object { (Split-Path $_ -Leaf) -like "CON-NODE01*" }); Stop-VM -VM $vm -TurnOff -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-VM -VM $vm -Force; foreach ($d in $disks) { Get-ChildItem (Split-Path $d) -File -Filter "CON-NODE01*" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }

$vm = Get-VM -Name CON-NODE02 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($vm) { $disks = @($vm | Get-VMHardDiskDrive | ForEach-Object Path | Where-Object { (Split-Path $_ -Leaf) -like "CON-NODE02*" }); Stop-VM -VM $vm -TurnOff -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-VM -VM $vm -Force; foreach ($d in $disks) { Get-ChildItem (Split-Path $d) -File -Filter "CON-NODE02*" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }

Invoke-Command -VMName CON-DC01 -Credential $cred { Remove-ADComputer CON-NODE01 -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-ADComputer CON-NODE02 -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Get-ADComputer -Filter "Name -like 'CON-CL01' -or Name -like 'CON-WEB'" }
